title: One-stage lifting of a fixed pair map
statement: Let I be a directed preorder, R a diagram of Noetherian rings, c an affine limit cone of Spec(R), and f: Xi -> Spec(R_i) quasi-compact, quasi-separated and locally finitely presented [def-pc-scheme, def-pc-morphism-conventions, def-pc-base-change]. Fix j >= i and a finite affine open cover U of the base change Xj. On each chart take a finitely presented quasi-coherent module N_d [pqf-def-coherent]. Take a module M on the limit base change and isomorphisms e_d from the limit pullbacks of N_d to the restrictions of M. For fixed indices a,b, there exists k >= j and a map on the overlap of the pullbacks of U_a and U_b to Xk whose limit pullback commutes with the transition of M under the canonical iterated chart comparisons [def-pc-local-overlap-transitions, def-pc-overlap-pair-canonical-comparisons]. This asserts the square only at k, with no persistence conclusion.

source.place: Tag 01ZR (2), first proof, lifting and gluing for one pair; Tag 05N7 (2), (3)

proof.text: Quasi-separatedness makes the intersection of the two affine charts quasi-compact and quasi-separated. Choose finite affine covers of this overlap and of its refinement intersections. Conjugate the restrictions of the transition of M by e_a and e_b. Their coordinate rings at the limit are the directed colimits of the stage rings; quasi-coherent pullback is scalar extension. The map clause of affine finite-presentation descent lifts each map; its equality clause makes these lifts agree on all refinement intersections at a common stage. Glue by sheaf locality. Transport along the canonical chart maps and pullback-composition comparisons to obtain the stated square at that single stage. An empty overlap has its unique map. Use the partial-order quotient of the nonempty tail above j for a preorder.

theorem exists_overlap_pair_map_at_stage
    {I : Type u} [Preorder I] [IsDirected I (· ≤ ·)]
    (R : I ⥤ CommRingCat.{u}) [∀ k : I, IsNoetherianRing (R.obj k)]
    (c : Cone (R.op ⋙ Scheme.Spec)) (hc : IsLimit c) [IsAffine c.pt]
    (i : I) {Xi : Scheme.{u}} (f : Xi ⟶ Spec (R.obj i))
    [LocallyOfFinitePresentation f] [QuasiCompact f] [QuasiSeparated f]
    (j : I) (hij : i ≤ j)
    (U : (pullback f (Spec.map (R.map (homOfLE hij)))).OpenCover.{u})
    [Finite U.I₀] [∀ a, IsAffine (U.X a)]
    (N : (a : U.I₀) → (U.X a).Modules)
    (hN : ∀ a, (N a).IsFinitePresentation) (hNq : ∀ a, (N a).IsQuasicoherent)
    (M : (pullback f (c.π.app (op i))).Modules)
    (e : ∀ a, (Scheme.Modules.pullback (U.pullbackHom
      (baseChangeMap f
        (T := Over.mk (Spec.map (R.map (homOfLE hij))))
        (T' := Over.mk (c.π.app (op i)))
        (Over.homMk (c.π.app (op j)) (c.w (homOfLE hij).op))) a)).obj (N a) ≅
      (Scheme.Modules.pullback ((U.pullback₁ (baseChangeMap f
        (T := Over.mk (Spec.map (R.map (homOfLE hij))))
        (T' := Over.mk (c.π.app (op i)))
        (Over.homMk (c.π.app (op j)) (c.w (homOfLE hij).op)))).f a)).obj M)
    (a b : U.I₀) :
    ∃ (k : I) (hjk : j ≤ k),
      let q := overlapStageMap R f hij hjk
      let V := U.pullback₁ q
      let p := overlapLimitMap R c f (hij.trans hjk)
      let A := fun d ↦ (Scheme.Modules.pullback (U.pullbackHom q d)).obj (N d)
      let W := V.pullback₁ p
      let D := (modulesPseudofunctor.toDescentData W.f).obj M
      let ε := overlapIteratedComparison U q p (overlapLimitMap R c f hij)
        (by
          dsimp only [p, q, overlapLimitMap, overlapStageMap]
          rw [← baseChangeMap_comp]
          congr 1
          ext
          simpa using c.w (homOfLE hjk).op) N M e
      ∃ φ : (Scheme.Modules.pullback (pullback.fst (V.f a) (V.f b))).obj (A a) ⟶
          (Scheme.Modules.pullback (pullback.snd (V.f a) (V.f b))).obj (A b),
        overlapPairSquare V A p D ε a b φ
